title: Abraham dines with angelic beings

tellings.quote: Abraham encounters a group [clears throat] of angelic beings and he has dinner with them.

plain: In the Bible's book of Genesis, Abraham meets a group of angelic beings at Mamre, in ancient Canaan, and sits down to dinner with them. The researcher Tim Alberino retells it from Genesis as an old account of people sharing a table with beings from beyond, which would matter as early testimony of such contact if read literally.
